description: Holder Count History. Calls only GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/holders-count-ts and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching historical Token-2022 and SPL token holder count. Get daily or hourly holder snapshots with net change data.

endTime.description: End time of period of interest as a unix timestamp.

interval.description: Enumerates the supported time intervals for token holders.

mintAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/holders-count-ts.

startTime.description: Start time of period of interest as a unix timestamp.

name: get-token-holder-count-history
title: Holder Count History
